// Package clones holds one clone between two Go files.
package clones

// SumB is a copy of the other file's function.
func SumB(xs []int) int {
	total := 0
	for i, x := range xs {
		if x%2 == 0 {
			total += x * i
		} else {
			total -= x
		}
		if total > 1000 {
			total = 0
		}
	}
	return total
}
